statement: Every source layout admits the audited quantization-safe stems, rectangles and rounded cog centers within the stated X/Y domains. Stems and cog centers have a strict total X order: bracket/cog support gaps are positive in their corresponding direction, stem widths and cog spacing are positive. Any ordered bracket pair must avoid each open X-overlap interval for rectangle pairs whose Y intervals overlap throughout both allowed Y domains. Merging the equivalent closed INTEGER forbidden sets preserves touching endpoints. The computed lower gap applies to every adjacent ordered pair. Every physical arrangement therefore maps to a path of six bracket types and two cogs in this weaker one-dimensional model. Dynamic-program states record earliest position of the last profile; earlier positions dominate later ones because all remaining constraints are lower differences and fixed coordinate domains. A backward latest-position recurrence independently reaches the same empty terminal set. Insert and nonadjacent exclusions were omitted, so their addition cannot create a solution.
scope: Same relaxed short-sheet target, original profiles, allowed bracket transforms and all real cog angles. Combined <=8 claim concerns the current checked55 continuation; other first-sheet arrangements and other targets remain open.
